description: This file implements functionality for parsing and managing a list of whitelisted origin-domain pairs for CORS policy, including JSON parsing, data management, and integration with WebKit security origins.

classes.name: JSONEntry
classes.description: Represents an origin-domain pair in the JSON whitelist, capable of parsing JSON data and holding origin, domain, and subdomain information.

methods.name: ParseWhiteList
methods.description: Parses a JSON string containing whitelisted origin-domain pairs and populates the internal data structure.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::Parse
methods.description: Creates a new WhiteListedOriginDomainsList instance by parsing a JSON whitelist string.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::AddWhiteListToWebKit
methods.description: Adds the stored whitelist entries into the WebKit extension's security origin access control.
